definition: two of the same kind working together
description: A wet old-town square with a stone fountain in spring. Two street drummers dressed exactly alike, in yellow bucket hats, yellow vests and black trousers, leap high into the air at the same moment with their drumsticks raised, land, and crouch to drum on two matching sets of upturned blue plastic buckets with cymbals. Then they stand up, laugh and tap their sticks together. A crowd of young people claps and cheers, pigeons fly up from the fountain, and café umbrellas line the square.

de.answer: Das Duo trommelt auf blauen Eimern.
